verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Core RESTful API, JS SDK, and CLI can create/manage machines and API keys (paperspace-docs-1, paperspace-docs-6, paperspace-docs-23, paperspace-docs-24), but there is no evidence that higher-level UI features like Notebooks, Deployments, Workflows, shared drives, or template management are fully exposed via the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (paperspace-probe-3). missing for 10: explicit API/CLI parity for Notebooks, Deployments, Workflows and other console-only features, plus an accessible API spec confirming full coverage.
